product_overview: Vahango is a ride-hailing platform focused on driver-first economics and reliable rider experience, offering OTP authentication, real-time driver location, fare estimation, ride booking, and integrated payments. The backend (Django + Channels) supports low-latency booking and matching as described in the PRD (see architecture and API sections, e.g., pages 6-9).
core_goals: Provide secure, low-latency rider authentication and session management via OTP.
Enable real-time driver location updates and reliable nearby driver matching (ETA < 5 mins).
Accurate fare estimation and a robust ride-request lifecycle with handling for edge cases (60s search timeout, cancellations).
Integrate payments and payouts for completed trips with reliable order creation and reconciliation.
Meet non-functional targets: API response times < 200ms for critical endpoints, 99.9% uptime, and support 10k concurrent sockets.

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Phone-number based OTP authentication for riders and drivers; issues session tokens for subsequent authorized requests.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/otp/ with {"phone_number": "<E.164>"} -> Receive 200 OK and OTP_SENT confirmation
POST /api/v1/auth/login/ with {"phone_number": "<E.164>", "otp": "<code>"} -> Receive 200 OK with JWT/access token and user role
POST /api/v1/auth/login/ with {"phone_number": "<E.164>", "otp": "<wrong>"} -> Receive 400 Bad Request with invalid OTP error

features.name: Rider API
features.description: Rider-facing endpoints to fetch nearby drivers and manage saved/favorite locations.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login/ with valid phone and otp -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/v1/rider/nearby/?lat=<lat>&lng=<lng> with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with list of nearby drivers (id, eta, distance)
POST /api/v1/auth/login/ with valid phone and otp -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/v1/rider/locations/all/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with saved locations array
GET /api/v1/rider/nearby/?lat=<lat>&lng=<lng> without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
GET /api/v1/rider/nearby/?lat=<invalid>&lng=<invalid> with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 400 Bad Request (invalid coordinates) or 422 Unprocessable Entity

features.name: Driver API
features.description: Driver-facing endpoints for sending frequent location updates and retrieving earnings reports.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login/ with driver phone and otp -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/v1/driver/update_location/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {"lat": <lat>, "lng": <lng>, "timestamp": "<iso>"} -> Receive 200 OK acknowledgement

POST /api/v1/auth/login/ with driver phone and otp -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/v1/driver/earnings/ with Authorization: Bearer <token>?range=daily -> Receive 200 with earnings summary (total, trips, breakdown)
POST /api/v1/driver/update_location/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> and missing lat/lng -> Receive 400 Bad Request (missing parameters)
GET /api/v1/driver/earnings/ with expired or invalid token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Ride API
features.description: Fare estimation and ride request endpoints to create and manage the ride lifecycle (searching, matching, acceptance).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login/ with valid rider phone and otp -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/v1/ride/estimate-fare/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {"src_lat": <lat>, "src_lng": <lng>, "dest_lat": <lat>, "dest_lng": <lng>, "vehicle_type": "<type>"} -> Receive 200 with fare_estimate {min,max,estimated_time}

POST /api/v1/auth/login/ with valid rider phone and otp -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/v1/ride/ride-request/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {"src_lat": <lat>, "src_lng": <lng>, "dest_lat": <lat>, "dest_lng": <lng>, "vehicle_type": "<type>", "payment_method": "<method>"} -> Receive 201 Created with ride_id and status="SEARCHING"

POST /api/v1/ride/ride-request/ with valid token when no drivers are available within 60s search window -> Receive 504 Gateway Timeout / 503 Service Unavailable with reason 'no drivers found within timeout'
POST /api/v1/ride/estimate-fare/ with malformed coordinates or missing fields -> Receive 400 Bad Request

features.name: Payments API
features.description: Create payment orders for trips; integrates with third-party payment gateway (order creation and return of payment URL/order id).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login/ with valid rider phone and otp -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/v1/payments/create-order/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {"ride_id": "<id>", "amount": <amount>, "currency": "INR", "method": "card|upi|wallet"} -> Receive 201 Created with {"order_id": "<order>", "payment_url": "<url>", "status": "pending"}
POST /api/v1/payments/create-order/ with Authorization: Bearer <token> and unsupported payment method -> Receive 400 Bad Request with 'unsupported payment method' error
POST /api/v1/payments/create-order/ without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
